description: This file defines data models for a backend API related to investment teaser generation, company info, file uploads, and scraping. It primarily uses Pydantic's BaseModel to structure request and response objects, including company details, file upload info, and teaser content.

classes.name: CompanyInfo
classes.description: Model representing basic company information, including optional fields for description, website, industry, contact info, and financial data.

classes.name: ScrapeRequest
classes.description: Model for requesting website scraping; contains the URL of the company's homepage.

classes.name: ScrapeResponse
classes.description: Model for the response after scraping, indicating success and providing company info.

classes.name: UploadRequest
classes.description: Empty model indicating a file upload request.

classes.name: UploadedFileInfo
classes.description: Details about an uploaded file, including filename, MIME type, size, and optional preview text.

classes.name: UploadResponse
classes.description: Response model containing information about uploaded files.

classes.name: ConfirmCompanyRequest
classes.description: Model for confirming or editing company info after user review.

classes.name: ConfirmCompanyResponse
classes.description: Acknowledgment response for company confirmation, including session ID.

classes.name: TeaserGenerationRequest
classes.description: Request model for generating an investment teaser, including session ID and optionally selected files.

classes.name: TeaserContent
classes.description: Structured content for an investment teaser, including teaser ID, title, content, company info, and timestamp.

classes.name: TeaserGenerationResponse
classes.description: Response after teaser creation, including status.

classes.name: ExportResponse
classes.description: Details for exporting a teaser, including download URL and metadata.
